scope: Fresh disposable project install and complete named bundle removal through the all-agent default, using native Pi/Codex catalogs; no models.

removal.method: Explicit bundle skill names, default all-agent removal; no wildcard, --all or -a, preserving unrelated installed skills.

earlier_agent_selected_attempt.observation: Agent-selected removal returned zero but retained shared canonical skills; the fresh supported command omits agent selection.

limitations: Installation uses a local source, not a new remote-download check.
Native Claude Code discovery is not measured; its project file/link paths are checked.
Fresh catalog processes are used; live-session reload and global installation/removal remain unverified.
The unrelated skill is introduced after installation and before removal; installation preservation covers existing application files only.
Package-created empty directories and lock metadata remain; named removal does not promise zero filesystem residue.
